website.note: Pipeline page references HCV combination and AT-527; details from 10-K

pipeline.modality: Oral small-molecule combination: NS5B nucleotide polymerase inhibitor (bemnifosbuvir) + NS5A inhibitor (ruzasvir)
pipeline.license_origin: Bemnifosbuvir owned by Atea; ruzasvir in-licensed from Merck/MSD (Dec 2021)

indications.trial_design: Two randomized, open-label Phase 3 trials comparing BEM/RZR vs sofosbuvir/velpatasvir; ~880 patients each; C-BEYOND in US/Canada (fully enrolled), C-FORWARD ex-North America (enrolling)
indications.trial_status: C-BEYOND ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (fully enrolled, topline mid-2026); C-FORWARD RECRUITING (topline year-end 2026); NDA targeted March 2027
key_milestones: First Phase 3 milestone payment $5M to Merck Apr 2025

indications.indication: Healthy volunteers / hepatic and renal impairment / DDI (supportive of HCV NDA)
indications.trial_name: Renal/hepatic impairment study; DDI with buprenorphine/naloxone or methadone

indications.trial_status: PLANNED - selected as HEV development candidate Jan 2026; Phase 1 initiation expected mid-2026

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Roche collaboration discontinued; COVID-19 program no longer active development priority
